name: Portulaca oleracea extract
description: Portulaca oleracea extract (CAS 90083-07-1 ), also marketed under the Turkish trade designation Semizotu Ekstraktı, is a botanical extract derived from purslane plant material. It is used across cosmetic, nutritional, and pharmaceutical formulations primarily for its antioxidant activity. The extract is valued for its moisture-retention properties in various industrial applications. In skincare and topical formulations, it functions as a humectant and antioxidant ingredient in serums, creams, and lotions targeting hydration. These products are specifically designed for oxidative stress reduction in modern dermatological care. Nutraceutical and functional food manufacturers incorporate it as a natural source of amino acids and nutrients to support product label claims. In pharmaceutical and healthcare preparations, it is used to enrich formulations with plant-derived bioactive compounds. This is particularly important where standardized botanical inputs are required for consistent manufacturing results. Cosmetic formulators also use it in sensitive-skin and anti-aging product lines. It is often selected where a naturally sourced antioxidant is preferred over synthetic alternatives to meet consumer demand for clean labels. Portulaca oleracea extract is typically supplied as a liquid extract or dry powder. The powder form is common for encapsulation and solid dosage applications within the supplement and pharmaceutical industries. Cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications are the most commercially available, with some suppliers offering standardized preparations. These standards ensure the extract meets the rigorous demands of global regulatory bodies. Packaging is generally available in small quantities for R&D through bulk volumes for industrial formulation.
